title: fanout_task item (FanOutTask)
description: One task (jobId, engagementId) against the ~1 min downstream (DISENO S4 (b)(c); FW-002). States are those of the Part 2 worker (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, FAILED, OBSOLETE; DEC-30).
$comment: Table fanout_task (per cell). PK = TASK#<jobId>#<engagementId>, SK = TASK. Sparse GSI1 (ready tasks): GSI1PK = RDY#<priority>#<firmId>#B<0..B_rdy-1>, GSI1SK = <createdAt>#<engagementId>, only while PENDING. Sparse GSI2 (leases): GSI2PK = LEASE#B<0..B_lease-1>, GSI2SK = <leaseUntil>, only while IN_PROGRESS. Sparse GSI3 (failed): GSI3PK = FAILED#<jobId>, GSI3SK = <engagementId>, only while FAILED. AP-F1 PutItem attribute_not_exists; AP-F3 Query GSI1 in creation order; AP-F4 conditional claim (state = PENDING OR (state = IN_PROGRESS AND leaseUntil < :now)); AP-F5 Query GSI2 SK < now; AP-F8 Query GSI3 and FAILED -> PENDING. Retries happen in the worker thread with backoff (no separate retry state). Downstream idempotencyKey = jobId:engagementId:targetVersion (NONE without target). TTL ttl = TTL_job when finished. Streams NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES -> EngagementVersionInspected.v1 (-> DONE), FanOutTaskDeadLettered.v1 (-> FAILED) (DEC-06).

GSI1PK.description: GSI1 (ready) partition key. GSI1PK = "RDY#<priority>#<firmId>#B<bucket>", bucket in 0..B_rdy-1.

GSI1SK.description: GSI1 (ready) sort key. GSI1SK = "<createdAt>#<engagementId>" (creation order within the firm).

GSI2PK.description: GSI2 (leases) partition key. GSI2PK = "LEASE#B<bucket>", bucket in 0..B_lease-1.

targetVersion.description: Target version label of the job; NONE in jobs without target (backfill, reconciliation, interactive). Part of the downstream idempotencyKey.

attempts.description: Attempts counted before each call (Part 2 beginAttempt); reset to 0 on a retry of FAILED tasks.

leaseOwner.description: Worker instance holding the lease (uuid, DISENO 3.8.1).

failureReason.description: Why the task is FAILED (Part 2 FailureReason; reasonCode of EV-25).

obsoleteReason.description: Why the task is OBSOLETE: newer publication of the same template, or job cancellation / version withdrawal.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_job (no value fixed in the docs). Set when the task reaches a terminal state.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Part 2 states (DISENO_FANOUT_WORKER.md 1.5): PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS (claim with lease) -> DONE | FAILED | PENDING (graceful shutdown); PENDING or own IN_PROGRESS -> OBSOLETE; FAILED -> PENDING only by the operator/CMD-06 retry. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
